record.content: \section{Introduction} Let's explore an example [1] of \textbf{Kepler's First Law}, also known as the Law of Ellipses, which states: \textit{The orbit of a planet around the Sun is an ellipse with the Sun at one of the two foci.} Formulated by Johannes Kepler in 1609, this law overturned the ancient assumption of circular orbits and laid the foundation for modern celestial mechanics. We'll use Earth's orbit around the Sun as a concrete example, breaking it down with real numbers and a touch of cosmic flair.
